title: Produce a localized, RTL-compatible interface prototype
prompt: Build a localized page with right-to-left direction and long translated labels.
objective: Logical flow, form controls, icons, content order, and keyboard focus remain clear in both directions.
target_skills: Using Bootstrap Through a CDN in Production
Bootstrap with npm and Version Control

expected_output: Logical flow, form controls, icons, content order, and keyboard focus remain clear in both directions.

public_tests.name: Human review
checklist: Behavior and acceptance criteria match the prompt.
Responsive behavior and keyboard operation are checked where relevant.
The learner can explain one implementation choice.

acceptance_criteria: Include and correctly use `dir="rtl"` where it belongs.
Include and correctly use `lang=` where it belongs.
Include and correctly use `text-start` where it belongs.
Test the example in its intended local runtime or record why execution is not available.
Check a relevant responsive or interaction state.
Explain one design trade-off or limitation.
hints: Break the request into the smallest visible requirements.
Start from semantic HTML and add the Bootstrap primitive that matches the interface purpose.
Test one requirement at a time; inspect computed styles or browser console when the result differs.
grading_method: Server-side required-string smoke check plus human review. This does not prove runtime correctness, visual quality, or accessibility.
retry_policy: Retries are allowed. Incomplete or incorrect submissions do not complete the activity. XP is platform-controlled and is not configured by this exercise.
status_note: Draft until subject-matter review, local execution, rubric verification, and accessibility checks are complete.
